m_cap1.title: Chief Medical Officer
m_cap1.description: +4 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. You command the field hospital. Authority earned through blood and competence.

m_cap2a.title: Legendary Medic
m_cap2a.description: +8 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Survivors whisper your name. You've pulled people back from the abyss a hundred times.

m_cap2b.title: Living Legend
m_cap2b.description: +6 Max Health, +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. The complete medic. Heals, fights, survives. Everything the apocalypse needs.

m_cap3aa.title: Immortal Resolve
m_cap3aa.description: +10 Max Health. You've stared death in the face so many times it stopped trying. Maximum vitality achieved.

m_cap3ab.title: Guardian Angel
m_cap3ab.description: +6 Max Health, +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Nothing reaches the people behind you. An immovable shield of flesh and will.

m_cap3ba.title: Apex Healer
m_cap3ba.description: +4 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health. The medic who also happens to be the deadliest fighter in the squad.

m_cap3bb.title: God Complex
m_cap3bb.description: +6 Max Health, +0.015 Movement Speed, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. You decide who lives and who dies. And you always live.

m_cm1.title: Combat Medic
m_cm1.description: +2 Attack Damage. Scalpels work on the living and the dead. You know where to cut to stop anything.

m_cm2a.title: Surgical Strike
m_cm2a.description: +3 Attack Damage. Target nerve clusters and arterial junctions. Medical knowledge weaponized.

m_cm2b.title: Defensive Blade
m_cm2b.description: +1 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health. Fight to survive, not to kill. Every swing buys time for the real weapon: medicine.

m_cm3aa.title: Anatomist
m_cm3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. You know every tendon, every joint, every weakness. The dead fall apart with surgical efficiency.

m_cm3ab.title: Mercy Kill
m_cm3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.01 Movement Speed. End suffering fast. Close distance, one clean cut, move on.

m_cm3ba.title: Unbreakable Resolve
m_cm3ba.description: +6 Max Health. The will to save others makes you harder to kill. Purpose is the best armor.

m_cm3bb.title: Warrior Healer
m_cm3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health. You heal AND you hurt. The complete combat medic  -  feared by the infected.

m_fs1.title: Field Surgery
m_fs1.description: +0.2 Attack Speed. Steady hands, fast hands. You operate under conditions that would make surgeons faint.

m_fs2a.title: Precision Cuts
m_fs2a.description: +0.3 Attack Speed, +1 Attack Damage. Every incision deliberate, every strike lethal. Anatomy is your weapon.

m_fs2b.title: Calm Under Pressure
m_fs2b.description: +0.2 Attack Speed, +3 Max Health. When chaos erupts, you get calmer. Slow pulse, fast hands, clear head.

m_fs3aa.title: Nerve Surgeon
m_fs3aa.description: +0.5 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Target nerve bundles with machine precision. The dead drop instantly.

m_fs3ab.title: Trauma Specialist
m_fs3ab.description: +0.3 Attack Speed, +4 Max Health. You specialize in trauma  -  both inflicting it and surviving it.

m_fs3ba.title: Bone Setter
m_fs3ba.description: +5 Max Health. Know how bones fit together means knowing how to keep yours intact. Structural mastery.

m_fs3bb.title: Master Surgeon
m_fs3bb.description: +0.4 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage, +2 Max Health. The complete package. Fast, lethal, nearly unkillable.

m_im1.title: Immunity
m_im1.description: +3 Max Health. Enhanced immune system. The spore can't get a foothold in your bloodstream.

m_im2a.title: Disease Resistant
m_im2a.description: +5 Max Health. Your white blood cells are monsters themselves. Nothing foreign survives inside you.

m_im2b.title: Adaptive Biology
m_im2b.description: +2 Max Health, +1 Luck. Your body learns from every encounter. Even bad luck teaches your cells something.

m_im3aa.title: Antibody Factory
m_im3aa.description: +7 Max Health. Your immune system mass-produces countermeasures. Every threat met and neutralized.

m_im3ab.title: Mutant Resilience
m_im3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Your biology adapted to the apocalypse. Stronger, tougher, inhuman.

m_im3ba.title: Lucky Survivor
m_im3ba.description: +2 Luck. You always find medicine when you need it. The universe owes you for all you've endured.

m_im3bb.title: Phoenix Blood
m_im3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +1 Luck. Your blood contains the cure to things that shouldn't have cures. Lucky AND immortal.

m_rc1.title: Recovery
m_rc1.description: +3 Max Health. You bounce back from injuries that would hospitalize others. Built different.

m_rc2a.title: Rapid Healing
m_rc2a.description: +5 Max Health. Wounds close in hours, not days. Your metabolism is a furnace burning through damage.

m_rc2b.title: Pain Management
m_rc2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Control the pain, control the body. Keep moving regardless of wounds.

m_rc3aa.title: Regeneration Factor
m_rc3aa.description: +8 Max Health. Your cells divide at superhuman rates. What kills others barely slows you down.

m_rc3ab.title: Second Wind
m_rc3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.012 Movement Speed. Hit the wall? Push through it. Your body finds reserves that don't exist.

m_rc3ba.title: Endorphin Rush
m_rc3ba.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Pain triggers speed. The worse you hurt, the faster you move. Biology's last defense.

m_rc3bb.title: Undying Constitution
m_rc3bb.description: +5 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Your body simply refuses to quit. Death gets tired of trying.

m_rs1.title: Steady Stance
m_rs1.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Planted feet, steady hands. You don't flinch when the infected charge.

m_rs2a.title: Unshakeable
m_rs2a.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Medical staff don't panic. You've seen worse in the field hospital  -  stay rooted.

m_rs2b.title: Reactive Guard
m_rs2b.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +3 Max Health. Absorb impact, heal damage. A self-repairing wall.

m_rs3aa.title: Immovable Object
m_rs3aa.description: +0.3 Knockback Resistance. You ARE the rallying point. The squad forms up behind you because nothing moves you.

m_rs3ab.title: Fortress Medic
m_rs3ab.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +4 Max Health. Rooted deep with vitality to spare. The anchor of any team.

m_rs3ba.title: Regenerative Tank
m_rs3ba.description: +6 Max Health. Your body regenerates so fast that what pushes you back just fuels more growth.

m_rs3bb.title: Living Barricade
m_rs3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Part healer, part wall. The infected pile up against you uselessly.

m_sr1.title: Swift Response
m_sr1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Every second counts in triage. You sprint to the wounded before they bleed out.

m_sr2a.title: Emergency Sprint
m_sr2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Adrenaline-fueled bursts carry you across the battlefield in heartbeats.

m_sr2b.title: Nimble Healer
m_sr2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +3 Max Health. Fast enough to dodge, tough enough to take a hit. Perfect field medic.

m_sr3aa.title: First Responder
m_sr3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. You arrive before the screaming stops. Speed saves more lives than any drug.

m_sr3ab.title: Ambulance
m_sr3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +4 Max Health. Mobile medical unit. You carry the hospital on your back at full sprint.

m_sr3ba.title: Trauma Response
m_sr3ba.description: +5 Max Health. Your body learned to prepare for damage before it arrives. Pre-emptive resilience.

m_sr3bb.title: Field Marathon
m_sr3bb.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +3 Max Health. Run all day carrying wounded. Your endurance is legend among survivors.

m_tg1.title: Toughness
m_tg1.description: +4 Max Health. Dense bones and thick skin. You take hits like a heavy bag  -  and hit back.

m_tg2a.title: Unbreakable
m_tg2a.description: +6 Max Health. What doesn't kill you makes you harder. And nothing has killed you yet.

m_tg2b.title: Flexible Frame
m_tg2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Bend don't break. Absorb, redirect, survive.

m_tg3aa.title: Adamantine Body
m_tg3aa.description: +8 Max Health. Your body density rivals steel. The infected shatter their own fists punching you.

m_tg3ab.title: Vitality Engine
m_tg3ab.description: +5 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. A biological powerplant. Energy to heal, mass to absorb.

m_tg3ba.title: Natural Armor
m_tg3ba.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Your body grew its own protection. Calcium deposits harder than any plate carrier.

m_tg3bb.title: Living Fortress
m_tg3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. The ultimate medic tank. Unkillable, unmovable, unstoppable.

m_tr1.title: Triage
m_tr1.description: +3 Max Health. First rule of field medicine: keep yourself alive so you can keep others alive.

m_tr2a.title: Emergency Protocol
m_tr2a.description: +5 Max Health. When vitals crash, your training takes over. Body stabilizes through pure medical instinct.

m_tr2b.title: Quick Patch
m_tr2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.2 Attack Speed. Patch wounds in combat. Fast hands save lives  -  including your own.

m_tr3aa.title: Critical Care
m_tr3aa.description: +7 Max Health. You stabilize the unstabilizable. Death has to work harder when you're around.

m_tr3ab.title: Adrenaline Surge
m_tr3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Emergency hormones flood your system. Faster, stronger, harder to kill.

m_tr3ba.title: Surgical Speed
m_tr3ba.description: +0.4 Attack Speed. Your hands move with surgical precision at inhuman speed. Scalpel or machete  -  same technique.

m_tr3bb.title: Combat Surgeon
m_tr3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.3 Attack Speed. Operate under fire. Stitch wounds between swings. The ultimate field medic.

m_vt1.title: Healthy Body
m_vt1.description: +4 Max Health. Clean living in a dirty world. You take care of yourself when nobody else will.

m_vt2a.title: Peak Condition
m_vt2a.description: +6 Max Health. Your body is a temple built for survival. Every organ optimized, every system tuned.

m_vt2b.title: Balanced Vitality
m_vt2b.description: +3 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Health AND agility. The best medics arrive fast and stay standing.

m_vt3aa.title: Pinnacle
m_vt3aa.description: +8 Max Health. Medical knowledge turned inward. You've engineered your own body beyond natural limits.

m_vt3ab.title: Cardiovascular Elite
m_vt3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. A heart that won't quit and legs that carry you through hell.

m_vt3ba.title: Iron Blood
m_vt3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Fortified circulatory system. Impacts that stagger others barely register.

m_vt3bb.title: Bio-Fortress
m_vt3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Your biology is a fortress. Pathogens bounce off, impacts absorbed.
